hero.title: Terms of Use
hero.subtitle: Please read these terms carefully. By using HeatEx Direct, you agree to the rules governing our B2B sourcing platform.

acceptance.title: 1. Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.content: By accessing or using HeatEx Direct, you acknowledge that you have read, understood, and agree to be bound by these Terms of Use. If you do not agree with these terms, please do not use our platform or submit sourcing requests.

usePolicy.title: 2. Permitted Use of the Platform
usePolicy.content: HeatEx Direct is provided for commercial B2B sourcing and educational purposes. You may browse our directory, utilize our RFQ tools, and contact verified manufacturers for legitimate business inquiries. You agree not to scrape data, spam manufacturers, or use the platform for fraudulent activities.

privacy.title: 3. Verification and Accuracy
privacy.content: While we manually verify factory business licenses, production scopes, and ASME/ISO certificates to the best of our ability, the information is provided 'as is'. We rely on publicly available databases and documents provided by the manufacturers. We do not guarantee the absolute accuracy of every company profile or their future production capabilities.

disclaimers.title: 4. Platform Independence
disclaimers.content: HeatEx Direct acts as an information bridge and verification directory, not a party to your transactions. Any contract, payment, or manufacturing agreement is strictly between the buyer and the manufacturer. We do not inspect final goods, and we do not act as a trading company or legal representative for either party.

limitation.title: 5. Limitation of Liability
limitation.content: To the fullest extent permitted by law, HeatEx Direct shall not be liable for any direct, indirect, incidental, or consequential damages arising from the use of our platform, including but not limited to manufacturing defects, delivery delays, financial losses, or disputes with suppliers found through our directory.

changes.title: 6. Updates to Terms
changes.content: We reserve the right to update or modify these Terms of Use at any time. Changes will be effective immediately upon posting to this page. Continued use of the platform after any such changes constitutes your acceptance of the new terms.
